name: Twintao Palm
description: Strike with a palm that moves in time with the unseen second Way behind it.

name: Twintao Guard
description: Hold a guard that yields on one Way and stands on the other.

name: Twintao Step
description: Walk two Ways in one pace so the foe sees one step and meets another.

name: Twintao Counter
description: Answer a strike on the first Way and return it on the second.

name: Twintao Calm
description: Lay two calms on the target from two Ways until their rising qi lies flat.

name: Twintao Cleanse
description: Draw a taint out of an ally along one Way and let the second Way carry it off.

name: Twintao Bind
description: Hold the target between the two Ways so each effort to pull free tightens the other.

name: Twintao Strike
description: Land one blow along each Way at one instant so the foe cannot yield to both.

name: Twintao Mending
description: Mend a wounded ally by bringing flesh and qi into accord along both Ways until the hurt is gone.

name: Twintao Nullify
description: Turn a technique back into the natural order it was drawn from so it ceases to be.

name: Tao Sovereign
description: Rule the field by the calm of both Ways until every raised hand sinks without being struck.

name: Coretao Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the Core's even calm into the target.

name: Coretao Guard
description: Hold a guard that draws its steadiness from the Core and not from the arms.

name: Coretao Step
description: Step from the Core outward so the whole body follows without effort.

name: Coretao Counter
description: Meet a strike at the Core's still point and send it away spent.

name: Coretao Calm
description: Lay the Core's calm over a foe until their qi falls quiet and even.

name: Coretao Rinse
description: Rinse a curse or taint from an ally with a slow clear stream from the Core.

name: Coretao Strike
description: Throw a blow from the Core's stillness that lands before the foe sees it begin.

name: Coretao Mending
description: Mend a wounded ally with the Core's even qi until the body remembers its whole shape.

name: Coretao Phase
description: Pass through a wall or a blade as though the Core had no edge to it.

name: Horizon Tao
description: Spread the Core's calm to two horizons at once and still every blow thrown within them.

name: Bearertao Palm
description: Strike with a palm carrying the quiet weight of the Tao across a long way.

name: Bearertao Guard
description: Hold the guard of one who carries a heavy peace and will not spill it.

name: Bearertao Step
description: Pace steadily under the load and never lose the line of the Way.

name: Bearertao Sense
description: Feel the temper of a crowd and learn who among them wishes for peace.

name: Bearertao Counter
description: Turn aside a blow with the slow patience of one who has borne worse.

name: Bearertao Calm
description: Rest the Tao's quiet on a crowd until quarrels die in their throats.

name: Bearertao Cleansing
description: Take a poison or curse off an ally and carry it away on the Way.

name: Bearertao Bind
description: Hold a peace-breaker still with the patient grip of the Way.

name: Bearertao Strike
description: Deliver a single blow whose weight is the whole Way borne to the mark.

name: Bearertao Weight
description: Lay the quiet weight of the Tao on a foe until their violence cannot be raised.

name: Bearertao Flash
description: Cross the whole plateau in one still breath with the burden unspilled.

name: Plateau Bearer
description: Set down the whole burden of the Tao upon the field in the school's founding act.

name: Corepledge Palm
description: Strike with a palm that keeps the pledge made in the Core.

name: Corepledge Guard
description: Hold a guard that stands on the pledge and will not move from it.

name: Corepledge Step
description: Step along the line the pledge has laid and never depart from it.

name: Corepledge Counter
description: Turn aside any blow that was not sworn against the pledge.

name: Corepledge Calm
description: Lay the calm of the pledge on the field until oath-breakers feel it as weight.

name: Corepledge Binding
description: Hold the target by the law of the pledge until their word is mended.

name: Corepledge Strike
description: Strike by a pledge that natural law will not let fall short.

name: Corepledge Mending
description: Mend a wounded ally on the strength of the pledge until the hurt is closed.

name: Corepledge Seal
description: Seal the target's qi with the pledge so it cannot be used against the sworn.

name: Pledged Tao
description: Loose the Core's pledge as a Way no foe on the field can cross.
